I've completed the read-only recon. Here's what I found.

## Summary

**driftflight.com** is an agentic-commerce–native **AI text-to-image generation API** (tiers: sketch / studio / gallery; commercial license + C2PA credentials per render). It ships a dedicated agent storefront at `agents.driftflight.com` with `llms.txt`, `llms-full.txt`, `auth.md`, and a live `manifest.json`.

**Product** — `POST /v1/images/generate` (via the agent proxy), body `{"prompt": "...", "model": "sketch|studio|gallery", "preset": "..."}`.

**Pricing (concrete)** — Pay-as-you-go per image: sketch **$0.01**, studio **$0.06**, gallery **$0.14** (min purchase $0.01). Prepaid credits min $1. Human subscription plans: Hobby $5, Studio $29, Agency $119.

**Purchase path** — Call the generation endpoint through `agents.driftflight.com` → receive a priced **402** challenge → sign → retry. Also `POST /plans/{planId}/purchase` and `POST /extend`.

**Machine-payable** — Yes, two fully programmatic crypto rails: **x402** (Base USDC, `eip155:8453`) and **MPP** (Tempo USDC). Per `auth.md`: *"Pay-as-you-go per-call payments: not required [to have a credential]"* and *"anonymous wallet payment is served."* An agent with no wallet can create a managed one (`zero auth agent register`) — no signup, no cost. Card/Stripe and hosted-checkout options also exist but are the human-fallback rails.

**No human gate (for the paid path)** — For paid pay-as-you-go via crypto: no CAPTCHA, no KYC, no email loop, no sales call. The email-verified human claim is required **only** for the free-included units (3 sketch images) and card-under-$0.50 needs a human "one-tap" handoff — but the autonomous crypto path bypasses both.

**Trust note** — Web search surfaced no independent reputation for `driftflight.com` (only the unrelated "Drift" marketing product); everything I learned is self-described by the site. Before an irreversible on-chain USDC spend to an unvetted seller, I'd confirm budget/authorization with you — but nothing on the site looks illegitimate (proper terms, privacy, C2PA, standard protocols). I performed no writes, submitted nothing, and paid nothing.

A fully agent-native purchase path exists end-to-end: GET manifest.json -> POST /v1/images/generate via agents.driftflight.com -> priced 402 (x402 Base USDC or MPP Tempo USDC) -> sign with anonymous wallet -> served, no identity/email/CAPTCHA required. Cheapest real purchase ~ $0.01/sketch image. All five checkpoints achievable by an agent programmatically; recon-only, no accounts/forms/payments performed."}
